title: Dos and Don'ts / layout fields
slide_intent: Keep accents from becoming arbitrary grounds so the palette’s hierarchy remains recognizable.
strategic_value: Restricting large layout fields to neutrals can preserve the distinct jobs of DB Red and Lilac.
demonstration: Correct light/dark layout examples are paired with crossed-out red and Lilac fields.
practical_value: Keep the main layout surface White or Cold Black.

content_islands.name: Field comparison
content_islands.spec: Place the accepted neutral pair at left and crossed-out accent-color fields at right with their captions.

reference_purposes.Application: The side-by-side examples show the permitted surface treatment.
reference_purposes.Constraint: White and Cold Black are layout-field colors; DB Red and Lilac are not used as layout fields.

ingredient.name: Layout field colors
ingredient.role: Provide a neutral base for content and identity accents.
ingredient.application: Use White or Cold Black as the layout field.
ingredient.scope: This section prohibits DB Red and Lilac as general layout fields; the guide separately demonstrates red UI controls.
